title: UA-OSM: Uncertainty-Aware Object-Shaped Merging to Reduce Object Loss in 360° Surround-View Stitching (code, notebook and data)
description:
Simulation code, Google Colab validation notebook, raw result data and figures for UA-OSM, a merging method for four-camera automotive surround-view systems. It assigns each object's complete ground-projected footprint to one camera that detects it, dilates the region by tracker covariance, resolves multi-object conflicts by joint camera assignment and escalates to a driver warning when an object cannot be shown whole.

Includes a closed-form feasibility analysis of straight seams, pixel-level evaluation against fixed, dynamic-straight, curved mask-avoiding and one-camera-per-object baselines, ablations, statistics, and a scenario catalog of four times of day, three weather states and one to five objects. All merging results are simulated; see the README for limitations.
notes: Result data and figures are additionally released under CC BY 4.0.
